"Keen" is likely a reference to "Commander Keen", one of the early video game series developed by id Software, where John Carmack was a co-founder and lead programmer. The Commander Keen games were platformers released in the early 1990s, before Carmack and his team went on to create the more famous Doom and Quake series.
By naming his AI company "Keen Technologies", Carmack appears to be making a nostalgic nod to his roots in the gaming industry while signalling his shift towards AI development.
This reference serves to highlight how figures from various tech backgrounds, including gaming, are now entering the AI race, bringing their unique perspectives and expertise to the field. It also underscores the interconnected nature of the tech world, where investors and entrepreneurs often have fingers in multiple pies, so to speak.
